scientific_question: Does the deployment-visible direction-local neighborhood already contain a target-compatible action subspace, so that v146 failed because inverse-distance weighting was too rigid, or do locally similar observations remain target-incompatible even under a truth-aware linear-span upper bound?
scope: Post-open CPU-only mechanism diagnostic on the same 20 frozen PoolFire sentinels. It is not a deployable predictor, reconstruction result, resource result, external test, curved-ray result, or real BOST result.

label_free_sample_metric.per_key_design: reuse the frozen v146 155-dimensional direction-local deployment-visible design and its fold-fit-only whitening
label_free_sample_metric.sample_distance: square root of the arithmetic mean of the 96 per-key standardized squared RMS distances

post_open_diagnostics.action_vector: the 96 v143 Riesz-action labels selected by the frozen target-blind direction table for one sample
post_open_diagnostics.action_normalization: divide each action vector by its positive Euclidean norm; no sign flip
post_open_diagnostics.oracle_definition: orthogonally project the normalized query action vector onto the column span of the normalized action vectors from the sealed label-free sample neighbors
post_open_diagnostics.relative_neighbor_conflict: a candidate in the nearest five percent whose normalized target has scale-invariant relative L2 above 0.45 or cosine below 0.9 against the query target

decision_rule.cross_span8_passes: HEADROOM_LOCAL_SPAN8_REWEIGHTING_V147; v146 inverse-distance weighting is too restrictive, but a deployable coefficient rule remains unproven.
decision_rule.cross_span8_fails_cross_span32_passes: HEADROOM_WIDER_LOCAL_SPAN32_V147; eight-neighbor rank is insufficient, but the wider local action span has an oracle upper bound.
decision_rule.cross_span32_fails_within_span32_passes: FAIL_CROSS_TRAJECTORY_LOCAL_STATE_ALIGNMENT_V147; current deployment-visible state does not align the action subspace across trajectories.
decision_rule.cross_span32_and_within_span32_fail: FAIL_LOCAL_SPAN_CAPACITY_V147; even the generous same-trajectory local action-span upper bound misses the frozen gate, so do not enlarge the predictor.

authorization_after_decision.headroom_decision: freeze one minimal observation-only coefficient sentinel on CPU before any neural model or GPU request
authorization_after_decision.cross_alignment_failure: change or add a physically measurable deployment-visible condition state; do not increase model size
authorization_after_decision.local_span_failure: close the current sample-level direction-local representation and redesign the physical state or target
